title.zh: BRK261 数字队友三支柱与企业级治理全景架构
title.en: BRK261 Digital Teammate Three-Pillar & Enterprise Governance Architecture

label.zh: 1. 像同事一样协同（Collaborates Like a Colleague · Agent Accounts）
label.en: 1. Collaborates Like a Colleague (Agent Accounts & Omnichannel)

label.zh: 2. 像员工一样装备（Equipped Like an Employee · Plugins, CUA & MCP Apps）
label.en: 2. Equipped Like an Employee (Plugins, Computer Use & MCP Apps)

label.zh: 3. 在岗进化与员工级治理（Learns on the Job & User-Grade Governance）
label.en: 3. Learns on the Job & User-Grade Governance (Memory, Purview & FinOps)

detail.zh: 独立 Entra ID、专属邮箱与日历、组织架构汇报给经理 Vid
detail.en: Dedicated Entra ID, Exchange inbox, calendar & manager steward (Vid)

label.zh: 全场景原生办公入口（M365 Surfaces）

detail.zh: Teams 频道与私聊、Outlook 邮件收发、Word/PPT/Excel 评论 @提及
detail.en: Teams channels/chats, Outlook threads, and Word/PPT/Excel @mentions

detail.zh: 每日晨会倒计时自动播报、SharePoint 变更监听与多团队协同通知
detail.en: Daily launch stand-up countdowns and SharePoint file-change events

label.zh: 共享技能与统一插件包（Plugins）

detail.zh: 将团队 SOP 编码为 SKILL.md，聚合知识+工具+技能跨智能体复用
detail.en: Encode SOPs as SKILL.md; bundle Knowledge + Tools + Skills in one registry

label.zh: 计算机使用智能体（Computer Use）

detail.zh: 云浏览器填报法务表单，Windows 365 云电脑操作无接口 Java 采购桌面端
detail.en: Cloud browser web forms + Windows 365 Cloud PC for legacy Java desktop apps

label.zh: 记录系统与富交互微件（MCP Apps）

detail.zh: 以智能体自身身份读写 Dataverse 台账，对话内直出交互式地图与日历
detail.en: Agent-authenticated Dataverse SOR + interactive maps and calendars in chat

label.zh: 可视化共享记忆账本（Memory GA）

detail.zh: 沉淀个人偏好、跨轮次任务进度（CE-10033）与团队提速规程，支持随时审删
detail.en: Stores user preferences, run state (CE-10033) & speed optimizations with delete control

label.zh: 身份访问与敏感度防泄漏（Security）
label.en: Entra CA · Purview DLP · Agent Map

detail.zh: Agent Users 条件访问策略、敏感度标签隔离、禁删级最小权限与连接图谱
detail.en: Conditional Access on agent users, Purview sensitivity/DLP & insert/update-only RBAC

label.zh: 三级算力成本围栏（Spend Control）

detail.zh: 单次会话点数透视、单智能体 100% 触顶熔断、环境级配额封顶禁抽租户池
detail.en: Per-session credit telemetry, 100% Stop Usage cap, and fenced environment pools
